'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Jim Sharp DS Darth Vader (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Sharp]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)|OVS1-10-Darth_Vader-remaster.webp|label=Darth Vader (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Spank Me Frankie
* '''Deck name:''' I hate Hospitals
* '''Username:''' Jim Sharp
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
